div.head: II As 11
div.ab: [Be ðon ðe scyldgunge bæde æt ofslegenum.] [Ld] Ond we cwædon: se ðe scyldunga bæde æt ofslagenum þeofe, ðæt he eode ðreora sum to, twegen on fæderanmaga ⁊ þridda on medren, ⁊ þone aþ syllen, ðæt hy on heora mæge nane þyfðe nysten, ðæt he his feores wyrðe nære for ðon gilte; ⁊ hy gán siððan XII sume ⁊ gescyldigen hine, swa hit ær gecweden wæs; ⁊ gif ðæs deadan mægas ðider cuman noldon to ðam andagan, gilde ælc ðe hit ær sprece CXX scll'.

And we have declared that he who demands redress for a slain thief shall go with three others, two [of the three] belonging to the father's kindred and one to the mother's, and they shall give an oath that they know of no theft committed by their kinsman, for perpetrating which he deserved to be put to death. The homicide shall go with the twelve others and charge the dead man with guilt in the manner already ordained. And if the kinsmen of the dead man will not come thither at the appointed day, each of those who have demanded redress shall pay 120 shillings.

Be ðon ðe scyldgunge bæde æt ofslegenum. We cwædon be ðon ðe scyldgunga bæde æt ofslagenum ðeofe, þæt he eode ðreora sum, twegen fæderamagas ⁊ ðridda on medren, ⁊ ðone aþ sealde, þæt hi on heora mæge náne ðyfþe nysten, þæt he his feores wyrþe nære for ðæm gylt; ⁊ hio gan siþþan twelfa sum ⁊ gescylden hine, swa hit ær gecwæden wæs; ⁊ gif ðæs deadan mægas ðeder cuman nyllan to ðæm andagan, gylde ælc CXX scill. ðe hit ær spræce.
